officialText:
The department or department of transportation may require that plans implemented pursuant to the provisions of this section be filed with either such agency.

(Am. L.L. 2016/105, 9/28/2016, eff. 9/28/2016; Am. L.L. 2016/107, 9/28/2016, eff. 9/28/2016)

Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2009/052.
